name: Bar cart (mobile bar)
placement: At cocktail hour, near the entrance or lawn; keep 1.2 m clear in front for guests queuing. Height is approximate.
modeling: A top box 1.35 x 0.76 x 0.05 m at 0.9 m high, a lower shelf box at 0.3 m, four thin box posts, and two small wheel cylinders on each side at the base; optional umbrella pole above.
